Step.Text: PURPOSE: Header-path relay for the SO picker web viewer — receives the selected service order, closes the card, and hands off to ORD__OrdersDispatcher (transferToSOConfirm). Static call — the Globals::ServiceOrderSelector callbackScript dispatch is retired (Stage-3 ORD rewire).

Step.name: Insert Text
Step.Text: PARAMS: JSON object pk (text, required) — PrimaryKey of the chosen ServiceOrder number (text, required) — ServiceOrderNumber for the success dialog CALLED BY: the picker WV HTML embedded in SO__OpenSOPicker (815) — header path only (line path calls SO__TransferStavka directly). RETURNS: the dispatcher's Response_Finalize envelope. HISTORY: until 2026-07 this script stored the selection in Globals::ServiceOrderSelector and dispatched by name to its callbackScript key (CopyToOrder). The only header-path consumer is now the ORD transferToSO flow, so the dynamic dispatch and the shared-state blob are gone — the call is static and traceable. Closing the card returns focus to the caller window (IncomingOrders / IncomingOrders_phone), so the dispatcher reads the primka from the current record.
